subject: Private Deploy: cross-border traffic evacuation tabletop + evidence checklist
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Suzanne Kwan <suzanne.kwan@acme-retail.com>, ops-asia@cloudpartner.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-23T08:12:00+01:00
Subject: Private Deploy: cross-border traffic evacuation tabletop + evidence checklist

Hi Suzanne / ops team,

Thanks for agreeing to a short tabletop to validate our cross-border evacuation and failover behavior for your private VPC deployment. Objective: confirm we can route EU-origin traffic to a warm-standby APAC cluster (and back) within the agreed guardrails while preserving residency controls and auditability.

Proposed scope (45 min):
- 10m: Context & success criteria (RPO/RTO, legal constraints)
- 15m: Network failover scenario walkthrough (BGP tie-break, peering, NAT/egress changes)
- 10m: Verification steps (log evidence, KMS access, audit events)
- 10m: Next steps & outstanding artifacts

Please bring the following, ideally in advance:
- Current network diagram for the EU VPC and APAC warm-standby (stubs acceptable) [Attachment: network-diagram-v2.png]
- Any customer-side egress filter rules or CSP policy IDs that might block peered routes
- List of required audit events you need to see for compliance (SOC2 / regional law)

Internal notes: Marissa will cover how our canary routing and prefix-caching behave during failover; Karthik will call out the expected kernel/quantization impacts on runtime during re-route.

Can we run this on Tue 2026-08-25 09:00 SGT / 02:00 BST? If that doesn't work for you we can move to Wed.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Suzanne Kwan <suzanne.kwan@acme-retail.com>

Date: 2026-08-23T11:08:00+08:00
Subject: Re: Private Deploy: cross-border traffic evacuation tabletop + evidence checklist

Jonas, thanks for the invite. Tue 25 Aug at 09:00 SGT works for our APAC ops folks. A couple of quick asks ahead of the tabletop: 

1) Can you send an example of the audit event names/fields we should expect in the log export? We need to validate mapping to our SIEM.
2) For network diagrams, can you also include the CIDR ranges and peering auth methods (PSK vs. mutual TLS)? If you prefer, we can redact sensitive hostnames.
3) Are you planning an active traffic switch or a simulated BGP announcement only? We prefer a simulated announcement first.

Also looping in Peter Li from Global Bank (cc) — they have a similar private deployment and might be able to share a quick checklist from their legal team.

Cheers,
Suzanne
Director, Cloud Engineering
Acme Retail
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

On Mon, Aug 23, 2026 at 08:12 Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for agreeing to a short tabletop to validate our cross-border evacuation and failover behavior for your private VPC deployment...

Hi all — quick technical follow-up before the tabletop:

- Audit events: we'll produce the following (sample fields in parentheses):
  - route.failover.initiated (timestamp, origin-region, target-region, triggered-by)
  - model.serve.reparent (model_id, old_hostpool, new_hostpool, kv_cache_status)
  - kms.key.access (key_id, caller_identity, success)
  - audit.log.exported (range_start, range_end, sha256)
  We will drop a JSON sample into the shared drive link before the session.

- Peering auth: Redwood supports both PSK and mTLS for VPC peering termination. For private deploys we recommend mTLS where regulatorily allowed; PSK is supported for legacy networks but has shorter rotation windows.

- Evac mode: by default during our tabletop we'll run a non-invasive BGP announcement simulation (no active data-plane traffic switch). If Acme requests a controlled active switch, we'll need a signed ops authorization and a 30-min maintenance window to validate cache rehydration.

Attachments added: canary-policy-diff.pdf (high-level change log for the canary routing we propose) and evacuation-checklist.xlsx (checklist with evidence artifacts we capture).

Marissa
Sr. Product Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: canary-policy-diff.pdf]
[Attachment: evacuation-checklist.xlsx]
